SUMMARY: The architectural design and specification for BI-PF-1550 (Prompt and Persona Asset Compiler) successfully meets all enterprise criteria, enforcing AES-256-GCM encryption with HKDF key derivation, zero-plaintext packaging verification, and memory-only runtime decryption.
All implementation files, test suites, and language rules (Go for runtime core, Python for build-time tooling) comply strictly with enterprise engineering standards and specifications.
Top risks regarding key derivation mismatches and prompt leakage are comprehensively mitigated via automated tests and build-time release gates.
